note: Owen County KY (FIPS 21187) parcels are published only through the qPublic/Schneider PVA viewer (qpublic.net/ky/owen), a proprietary web app with no public ArcGIS REST service or file download found. Kentucky's state server (kygisserver) publishes PVA parcel services for some counties (e.g. Ky_PVA_Webster_Parcels_WGS84WM) but none for Owen; probes of Ky_PVA_Owen_Parcels_WGS84WM and the WGS84WM folder found nothing. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches returned no Owen County parcel service. Commercial sources (Acres, OGInfo, Rockford Map, Mapping Solutions) are paid products, not public services.
